resources.string: Check the unit power and the cable or Bluetooth. You will return to the same screen once the connection is restored.
Check the USB connection to the device.
The unit does not answer over the COM port. Check the cable and power; to update the firmware, put the unit into the bootloader — the screen will switch by itself.
The unit is off or too far away. Move the phone closer and check the unit power.
Waiting for the unit to return…
